name: inspira-animated-beam

frames.best_why: Frame 3 is the only one where the travelling glow is clearly lit, red-orange along the third beam.

tagline: Hairline curves link four small icons to a hub, with a light sliding along them.
summary: A connector graphic: four small circular nodes on the left feed through gently bowed hairlines into one larger circle on the right, while a coloured light runs along each path in turn.
appearance: On a near-black stage, four small round outlined buttons stack down the left, each holding a tiny coloured shape. Four faint grey curves bow rightward into a larger circle holding a purple atom, its ring picked out in indigo.
behaviour: Each path carries a short colour gradient that slides from the source node to the hub on a loop, staggered per beam. The lines are recomputed when the container resizes.
demo_content: Four small circles (blue diamond, green dot, red dot, yellow dot) feed a larger purple atom circle.
search_phrases: lines connecting icons to a centre hub
flow lines with a moving light
node connection graphic for a tech stack
svg path that pulses between elements
diagram linking inputs to one service
use_when: A hub should read as connected to several inputs, with a slow moving light hinting at flow.
avoid_when: It needs refs on a container plus two elements each and a positioned parent; alone it renders nothing.
customise: Give it container, from and to refs; curvature, reverse, both gradient colours, path colour, width, opacity, delay and duration are all props.
weight_why: A single SVG path and one looping gradient animation per beam; the demo mounts four.

a11y.note: Decorative SVG with no title or aria-hidden, and the endless beam loop never checks reduced-motion.

issues: The connector hairlines are very faint grey, so in most frames the moving light is almost invisible.
polish_why: Tidy, well-proportioned diagram; the very low line contrast holds it back.
